purpose: Capture the trader's real discretionary timing, key-zone selection, live force/tug-of-war judgment, and first meaningful reaction-cluster TP selection with a desktop replay experience. Fidelity only; never edge certification or PnL-driven tuning.

gold_reference.rule: User screenshots/videos are private hashed gold references for scenario coverage and post-freeze interpretation; they are never shown as answers inside the blind replay UI.

tp_semantics.instruction: Mark the first meaningful reaction cluster the trader would actually use as TP. Do not redefine reaction cluster as merely adjacent or side-by-side candles.
tp_semantics.pre_entry_directional_planning: The trader may mark bullish and bearish TP plans before direction is confirmed, but the opposite-direction TP is optional.
tp_semantics.presented_context_gap_rule: If the replay chart has open space and does not present a meaningful reaction/key level in a direction, record the explicit context-gap status instead of inventing a numeric TP. This is a fidelity/context limitation and does not prove ROOM_TO_FIRST_REACTION passed.

replay_clock.formal_blind_evidence_warning: Because a static local artifact contains later replay bars for interactive stepping, V3 is style/fidelity capture and must not be represented as cryptographically sealed no-future evidence. A server-streamed version would be required for that stronger claim.

non_goals: showing bot answers before trader labels freeze
inventing a TP when the presented chart does not contain a meaningful reaction
